test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which country is the host of "Vostok-2022" military exercise?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Russia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vostok - 2022, a multilateral strategic and command exercise, has started from 01 to 07 September 2022 at the training ground in the Eastern Military District of Russia.
 
• The objective of the exercise is to interact and coordinate between the other participating contingents and observers.
 
• The Indian Army contingent of 7/8 Gorkha Rifles troops had reached the exercise location and will conduct joint exercises over the next seven days including joint field training exercises, war discussions, and shelling exercises.
 
• The Indian Army contingent looks forward to share practical aspects and put into practice the practice amalgamation of validated practices, procedures, and new technology through discussions and tactical exercises.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
